{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Check if customer_age == -1 is systematically different between channels
age_summary = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].agg(['mean', 'count', 'std'])
print("Mean age by channel:")
print(age_summary)

# Check if customer_age == -1 is balanced across channels
missing_age_by_channel = filtered_df[filtered_df['customer_age'] == -1].groupby('channel').size()
print("\nMissing age (age = -1) by channel:")
print(missing_age_by_channel)"}
